gui.grimpipes.distribution.title: Distribution
gui.grimpipes.distribution.round_robin.t: Outputs with the same priority take turns.

gui.grimpipes.distribution.random.toolti: Picks a random output each time.

gui.grimpipes.overview.subtitle: Every end of the pipe at %s, %s, %s
gui.grimpipes.overview.hint: Click an end to open its settings. Right-click to switch Input and Output.
gui.grimpipes.tag_filter.sub: Rules, separated by commas or spaces:
jei.grimpipes.pipe: Pipes move items, fluids, energy and chemicals between blocks. Place them in a line, then click the end you want to pull from with the Reaper Wrench to make it an Input (gold plate). Right-click a placed pipe with a different pipe to bundle both into one block; each strand connects to the same side on its own.
jei.grimpipes.upgrade: Speed cards go only in Input ends: right-click the gold end plate with the card, or put it in the end's card slot. One card speeds up the whole line.
jei.grimpipes.wrench: Click an end: Output / Input. Sneak-click an end or click a link: disconnect. Click a core: reconnect. Sneak-click a core: take that strand out. Click a disguised pipe: remove the facade.
jei.grimpipes.tag_filter: Right-click to type rules like #c:ingots, @mekanism or *_log, then put it in any filter slot. Works for items and fluids.
jei.grimpipes.imprint: Sneak-click an end to copy its settings, then click other ends to paste them. Speed cards are never copied.
jei.grimpipes.soul_link: Click one pipe, then another in the same dimension: they join into one network, no pipes needed in between. Both pipes must be loaded.
jei.grimpipes.field_guide: The in-game manual for Grim Pipe Industries.
jei.grimpipes.facade: Sneak-right-click a pipe with any plain full block to hide the pipe inside it. It keeps working. Click it with the wrench to get the block back.
guide.grimpipes.0.title: Welcome
guide.grimpipes.0.text:
Grim Pipe Industries moves items, fluids, energy and Mekanism chemicals with clean, lag-free pipes.

Pipes store nothing and never tick. Turn the pages to learn the whole mod in two minutes.
guide.grimpipes.1.title: Five Pipes
guide.grimpipes.1.text:
Item, Fluid, Energy, Chemical and Omni (all four at once).

Right-click a placed pipe with a different pipe to bundle both into one block. Every strand connects to the same side of a machine on its own.
guide.grimpipes.2.title: The Wrench
guide.grimpipes.2.text:
Click an end: switch Output (purple) / Input (gold).
Sneak-click an end, or click a link: disconnect.
Click a core: reconnect.
Sneak-click a core: take that strand out.

Input ends pull from the block they touch.
guide.grimpipes.3.title: Speed Cards
guide.grimpipes.3.text:
Whispering, Restless, Wraithbound, Soulforged.

Cards go only in Input ends, never in the pipes between. Right-click the gold end plate with a card, or use the end's screen. The card color shows on the plate.
guide.grimpipes.4.title: End Screens
guide.grimpipes.4.text:
Empty-hand right-click an end to open it.

Input: card, filter, redstone control and distribution (round-robin, nearest first, random).
Output: priority (higher fills first) and filter.

Sneak-click a pipe with an empty hand to see every end of that block at once.
guide.grimpipes.5.title: Filters
guide.grimpipes.5.text:
Whitelist, Blacklist, or Void (Input only).

Put items in the 9 slots; buckets filter fluids. The book button turns on exact matching (enchantments, contents and other data).

A Reaper Tag Filter matches by rule: #c:ingots, @mekanism, *_log.
guide.grimpipes.6.title: Redstone
guide.grimpipes.6.text:
Input ends can run Always, only with a signal, or stop with a signal. Power the pipe block itself.

Anything machines push into an Input end follows the same redstone and filter rules.
guide.grimpipes.7.title: Reaper Imprint
guide.grimpipes.7.text:
Sneak-click an end to copy its settings. Click other ends to paste.

Copies Input/Output, filter, filter mode, redstone, priority and distribution. Speed cards stay where they are.
guide.grimpipes.8.title: Soul Link
guide.grimpipes.8.text:
Click a pipe, then another one anywhere in the same dimension. Their networks become one, with no pipes in between.

Both ends must be loaded: pipes never load chunks. Sneak-click to break a link.
guide.grimpipes.9.title: Facades
guide.grimpipes.9.text:
Sneak-right-click a pipe with a plain full block to hide the pipe inside it. It keeps working, and looks exactly like the block.

Click it with the wrench to take the block back.

Liquid Experience from Grim Soul Industries tanks flows through Fluid and Omni pipes.
